answer: Who vouches for a new man when nobody in the town knows his face? The record does. Comb maker tooth record with comb makers attestation is the voucher the town trusts: five-year record, 8,000 combs cut, horn accounts, yearly fees. Offer a borrowed beacon and the application dies on the table, the sponsor loses his deposit of twice the yearly dues and the zenith is handed to the parish chest, while the haven is filed away and shown to any challenger.
